claims.why_locus: The complete-discovery-path sentence is claim_under_test_for_downstream. DESIGN's actual rule is index_text_excludes_body: presence in the index is not selection.

question: Refute the gateway: argue it becomes the single point of epistemic failure for capability discovery. Construct the concrete case where a correct capability exists, is installed, is relevant, and is NEVER selected - then show why the resulting silence is undetectable from inside the gateway's own telemetry, and name the external signal that would detect it.
required_fix: Do not rebuild A4. Keep labelled recall on an external confirmer (ARC-0029 / CNF-0177). Gateway turn_ok stays an operational health bit.

reviewer.method: Mechanical scope check: every REFUTED row has defect_locus in {DESIGN, SENTENCE} and a scoped_restatement; both loci appear; at least one CONFIRMED row exists; dossier and live-tree anchors resolve; the miss is computed by running the gateway, not asserted. Agreement with the complete-discovery REFUTED verdict is not required. Author objection alone cannot flip REFUTED. No A4 rebuild is requested.

scenario.catching_architecture: A1 config-first always-on: skill.council's body is resident without surviving a select() hit, so the four-voice instructions are in context on this task. Cost is flooding, which is why A4 exists; A1 still catches this omission.
scenario.on_this_estate: Live registry command-center/p2-wave/probes/ARC-0010/registry.json installs skill.council (four named roles in the body) and wf.catalog-class.discovery-only. DESIGN index_text is kind+name only. The task asks for Architect/Skeptic/Pragmatist/Critic to review catalog-class discovery. A4 selects the workflow; gold is never selected; turn_ok stays true.
procedure: 1. Load live A2 registry capabilities; confirm skill.council and wf.catalog-class.discovery-only are installed.
2. Build the A4 index: index_text = kind + name (bodies and roles excluded).
3. Run select() on the four-voice catalog-class review task. Record selected_ids, scores, telemetry.
4. Observe: skill.council is indexed and installed, never selected; wf.catalog-class.discovery-only is selected; all gateway metrics green.
5. Control: body-aware overlap selects skill.council. A1 always-on has skill.council resident.
6. Uninstall skill.council and re-run A4: turn metric vector is identical. Index membership is the out-of-band distinguisher, not telemetry.
scenario.title: Installed skill.council is relevant and never selected; gateway telemetry stays green

strongest_surviving_counterargument: Lazy-activation still bounds the resident set to index rows plus the selected bodies. Putting labelled recall inside the gateway would make the selector depend on a gold corpus it is supposed to be measured against, and would rebuild A4 into a supervised ranker (the ADV circle). The surviving claim: A4 indexes and lazily activates; it does not certify that the selected set is the relevant set. That claim is CONFIRMED by DESIGN. Detection of relevant-but-unselected capabilities belongs on an external labelled-recall confirmer (catalog ARC-0029 / CNF-0177), not in gateway turn_ok.
